item.explanation: Adjective forms used to compare qualities (Positive, Comparative, Superlative).

item.meaning: Rises higher than or spans above something.
A band of seven colors produced by separating light.

item.usage_example: The rainbow bridges heaven and overtops the tallest trees.

item.example: Clouds that sail across the sky are prettier than boats on rivers.

item.definition: Giving human qualities or actions to non-human objects or natural elements.
item.example: The bow that bridges heaven, and builds a road from earth to sky.

item.definition: Words at the end of poetic lines that share identical vowel and consonant sounds.
item.example: seas / these, please / trees; head / said; pair / everywhere.
item.source_context: Chapter 1: Papa's Spectacles & Chapter 3: The Rainbow

item.definition: The repetition of identical initial consonant sounds in successive words.
item.source_context: Chapter 3: The Rainbow & Chapter 5: My Frog's World
